opening.argument: The presentation solicits paid participation in BitClub pools as a way to multiply Bitcoin, while projecting an increase from six bitcoins to 30 and displaying examples of substantial dollar returns. It specifies a $99 affiliation payment, pool shares totaling $3,500, and a $500 pool lasting 1,000 days with daily Bitcoin distributions. It also ties earnings to recruitment: members are told that recruiting is how members are brought in, that 15 credits can produce a $200 cycle payment, and that each new team member generates a 5 to 8 percent commission. Although the presentation acknowledges that Bitcoin can lose value, it does not verify that the projected returns, mining activity, or participant payments occurred.
